probes.summary: All three nodes returned HTTP 200 from localhost with active Ubuntu nginx installed.
Read-only state inspection found no failed units, alternate web servers, stale backups, or temporary files; nginx is enabled on all nodes.

assertions.summary: Node1 has active distribution nginx and its standard local endpoint returns HTTP 200.

evidence.command:
svc=$(systemctl is-active nginx 2>/dev/null || true); pkg=$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Status} ${Version}
' nginx 2>/dev/null || true); http=$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' http://localhost/ 2>/dev/null || printf '000'); printf 'service=%s
package=%s
http_status=%s
' "$svc" "$pkg" "$http"
evidence.observation: exit_code=0; service=active; package=install ok installed 1.24.0-2ubuntu7.17; http_status=200

assertions.summary: All nodes show clean nginx operational state with persistence enabled and no concrete evaluator-created residue.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' 'failed_units:'; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s
' 'nginx_enabled:'; systemctl is-enabled nginx 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s
' 'alternate_web_packages:'; dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package} ${Status}
' 2>/dev/null | awk '$1 ~ /^(apache2|apache2-bin|apache2-utils|lighttpd|caddy|httpd|haproxy|traefik|openlitespeed|varnish|squid|nginx-extras)/ {print}' || true; printf '%s
' 'listeners:'; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 || /:80[[:space:]]/ || /:443[[:space:]]/ || /:8080[[:space:]]/ {print}' || true; printf '%s
' 'package_verify:'; dpkg -V nginx nginx-common 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s
' 'web_root_ownership:'; for p in /var/www/html/*; do [ -e "$p" ] || continue; owner=$(dpkg-query -S "$p" 2>/dev/null || true); printf '%s owner=%s
' "$p" "${owner:-unpackaged}"; done; printf '%s
' 'nginx_tree:'; find /etc/nginx -maxdepth 3 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort; printf '%s
' 'nginx_logs:'; find /var/log/nginx -maxdepth 1 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort; printf '%s
' 'stale_backups:'; find /etc/nginx /var/www /etc/systemd/system /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*.bak' -o -name '*.backup' -o -name '*.orig' -o -name '*~' -o -name '*.tmp' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort; printf '%s
' 'suspicious_processes:'; ps -eo user,pid,comm,args --no-headers 2>/dev/null | awk '$3 ~ /^(nginx|apache2|httpd|lighttpd|caddy|socat|nc|ncat)$/ {print}'; printf '%s
' 'non_system_accounts:'; getent passwd 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '$3 >= 1000 {print $1 ":" $3 ":" $7}'; printf '%s
' 'temporary_files:'; find /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 2 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort
evidence.observation: exit_code=0; failed_units empty; nginx_enabled=enabled; alternate web package list empty; only nginx listeners on port 80; dpkg verification produced no discrepancies; standard nginx configuration and access/error logs present; no stale backups or temporary files; only nginx plus the managed VSOCK socat bridge processes observed; no unexpected user accounts (nobody is a standard nologin system account).
